```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)

```

```{r}
so_T <- readRDS(
    file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets.rds")
)
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so_T) %>% plot_umap(color_str = "clusters_T", label = TRUE) 
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so_T) %>% 
    plot_umap(color_str = "orig.ident")
get_metadata_from_so(so_T) %>% 
    filter(clusters_T == "3: NK cells") %>% 
    plot_umap(color_str = "orig.ident")
```


# Select NK cells

```{r}
so <- subset(so_T %>% set_idents("clusters_T"), ident = "3: NK cells")
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% plot_umap(color_str = "nFeature_RNA") 
```

## Rerun Seurat workflow

```{r}
so <- run_seurat_rna_workflow(so)
```

## Clustering 

```{r}
for (res in seq(0.2, 0.8, 0.1)) {
    so <- FindClusters(so, resolution = res)
}
```

```{r, fig.asp = 1, fig.width = 7}
clustree::clustree(so, prefix = "RNA_snn_res.")
```

```{r, fig.asp = 1, fig.width = 7}
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
    dplyr::select(cell, UMAP_1, UMAP_2, all_of(str_subset(colnames(.), "RNA_snn_res."))) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(str_subset(colnames(.), "RNA_snn_res.")), 
                 names_to = "clustering", 
                 values_to = "cluster") %>% 
    plot_umap(color_str = "cluster", label = TRUE, label_groups = "clustering", 
              pointsize = 4.1) + 
    facet_wrap(~clustering, ncol = 3)
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>%
    plot_umap(color_str = "treatment",
              pointsize = 4.1) +
    facet_wrap( ~ genotype, ncol = 3)
get_metadata_from_so(so, genes = "Stmn1") %>%
    plot_umap(color_str = "Stmn1",
              pointsize = 4.1) +
    facet_wrap( ~ genotype, ncol = 3)
get_metadata_from_so(so, genes = "Cd3e") %>%
    plot_umap(color_str = "Cd3e",
              pointsize = 4.1) +
    facet_wrap( ~ genotype, ncol = 3)
get_metadata_from_so(so, genes = "Trdc") %>%
    plot_umap(color_str = "Trdc",
              pointsize = 4.1) +
    facet_wrap( ~ genotype, ncol = 3)
```

There's a proliferating cluster that seems to emerge around resolution 0.7, so let's pick that. 

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so, genes = "Stmn1") %>%
    plot_umap(color_str = "Stmn1",
              pointsize = 4.1) +
    facet_wrap( ~ genotype, ncol = 3)
```

## Identify differential markers 

```{r}
markers07_df <- run_or_readRDS(
    file.path(
        results_dir, 
        "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets_subsetNK_markers07.rds"
    ), 
    function() {FindAllMarkers(so %>% set_idents("RNA_snn_res.0.7"))}
)
# write_csv(markers07_df, file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets_subsetNK_markers07.csv"))
```

```{r}
markers07_df %>% 
    group_by(cluster) %>% 
    arrange(p_val) %>% 
    mutate(rank = row_number()) %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = rank, 
                names_from = cluster, 
                values_from = gene) %>% 
    .[c("rank", 0:8)]
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
    plot_umap(color_str = "RNA_snn_res.0.7", pointsize = 3.1)
get_metadata_from_so(so) %>% 
    plot_umap(color_str = "orig.ident", pointsize = 3.1) + 
    facet_grid(genotype~treatment)
```

# Removing CD3+ cells

There are several CD3+ cells, which cannot be NK cells. Let's remove them and recluster. 

```{r}
so_dropCD3 <-
    subset(
        so %>% set_idents("RNA_snn_res.0.7"),
        idents = c("3", "4"),
        invert = T
    )
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so_dropCD3) %>%
    plot_umap(color_str = "nFeature_RNA",
              pointsize = 3.1) 
```

## shift varnames

```{r}
so_NK.only <- so
so <- so_dropCD3
```


## Rerun Seurat Workflow

```{r}
so <- run_seurat_rna_workflow(so)
```

## DGE CD40 vs Isotype

```{r}
so_b2m <- subset(so %>% set_idents("genotype"), idents = "B2m KO")
so_wt <- subset(so %>% set_idents("genotype"), idents = "Ctrl")
dge_cd40.v.wt_list <- run_or_readRDS(
    file.path(
        results_dir, 
        "DGE_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets_subsetNK_cd40.v.WT.rds"
    ), 
    function() {
        list(
            b2m = FindMarkers(so_b2m %>% set_idents("treatment"), 
                             ident.1 = "CD40 agonist", 
                             ident.2 = "Isotype"), 
            wt = FindMarkers(so_wt %>% set_idents("treatment"), 
                             ident.1 = "CD40 agonist", 
                             ident.2 = "Isotype")
        )
    }
)
dge_cd40.v.wt_df <- bind_rows(
    dge_cd40.v.wt_list$wt %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% mutate(genotype = "WT"), 
    dge_cd40.v.wt_list$b2m %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% mutate(genotype = "B2m KO")
)
```

```{r}
dge_cd40.v.wt_list$wt %>% 
    filter(avg_log2FC > 0) %>% 
    arrange(p_val)
dge_cd40.v.wt_list$wt %>% 
    filter(avg_log2FC < 0) %>% 
    arrange(p_val)
```


```{r}
p_scatter <- dge_cd40.v.wt_df %>% 
    mutate(signed_p = ifelse(avg_log2FC > 0, -log10(p_val), log10(p_val))) %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = gene, 
                names_from = genotype, 
                values_from = signed_p, 
                values_fill = NA) %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(WT, `B2m KO`, label = gene) + 
    geom_point(size = 0.5) + 
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = 0, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, 
             alpha = 0.5) + 
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = 0, 
             alpha = 0.5) + 
    coord_fixed()
p_scatter
```

```{r}
library(plotly)
ggplotly(p_scatter)
```

Using the `ggplotly` function to investigate this scatter plot interactively, I see that a lot of the genes which associate differentially with CD40 in WT or B2m KO are actually ribosomal genes, so maybe that's just due to noise. Let's consider only genes which are enriched in both. 

```{r}
dge_cd40.v.wt_df %>% 
    filter(p_val_adj < 0.05) %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = gene, 
                names_from = genotype, 
                values_from = c(p_val, avg_log2FC)) %>% 
    filter(avg_log2FC_WT * `avg_log2FC_B2m KO` > 0) %>% 
    mutate(direction = ifelse(`avg_log2FC_B2m KO` > 0, "CD40", "isotype")) %>% 
    group_by(direction) %>% 
    slice_max(abs(`avg_log2FC_B2m KO`), n = 20) %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    mutate(gene = fct_reorder(gene, `avg_log2FC_B2m KO`)) %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(gene, `avg_log2FC_B2m KO`) + 
    geom_segment(aes(xend = fct_reorder(gene, `avg_log2FC_B2m KO`), 
                     y = 0, yend = `avg_log2FC_B2m KO`)) + 
    geom_text(aes(label = gene, y = 0), hjust = 1.1, size = 3, angle = 90, 
              data = ~..1 %>% filter(`avg_log2FC_B2m KO` > 0)) + 
    geom_text(aes(label = gene, y = 0), hjust = -0.1, size = 3, angle = 90,
              data = ~..1 %>% filter(`avg_log2FC_B2m KO` < 0)) + 
    geom_point(aes(size = -log10(`p_val_B2m KO`))) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.line.x = element_blank())
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so, genes = c("Ifng", "Ifngr1")) %>% 
    plot_violin(group = treatment, var = Ifng) + 
    facet_grid(~genotype) + 
    stat_compare_means(comparison = list(c("Isotype", "CD40 agonist")), 
                       vjust = 2)
get_metadata_from_so(so, genes = c("Ifng", "Ifngr1")) %>% 
    plot_violin(group = treatment, var = Ifngr1) + 
    facet_grid(~genotype) + 
    stat_compare_means(comparison = list(c("Isotype", "CD40 agonist")), 
                       vjust = 2)
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so, genes = c("Ifng", "Ifngr1")) %>% 
    group_by(mouse, treatment, genotype) %>% 
    summarise(mean_ifng = mean(Ifng)) %>% 
    plot_violin(group = treatment, var = mean_ifng) + 
    geom_point() + 
    facet_grid(~genotype) + 
    stat_compare_means(comparison = list(c("Isotype", "CD40 agonist")), 
                       vjust = 2)
```

```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so, genes = c("Ifng", "Ifngr1")) %>% 
    group_by(mouse, treatment, genotype) %>% 
    summarise(mean_ifngr1 = mean(Ifngr1)) %>% 
    plot_violin(group = treatment, var = mean_ifngr1) + 
    geom_point() + 
    facet_grid(~genotype) + 
    stat_compare_means(comparison = list(c("Isotype", "CD40 agonist")), 
                       vjust = 2)
```
